title: Rwanda | World Coffee Guide
description: Rwandan coffees can be bright and juicy, with red fruit, citrus and a black tea finish when a washing station has taken care over them. Almost all of it is washed Bourbon grown by smallholders in the hills of the Western and Southern provinces, around Lake Kivu, Huye and Nyamagabe.
seoDescription: Rwanda coffee guide: Nyamasheke, Bourbon, washing stations, potato defect, USDA PSD production.
